name: Portugal House Purchase Benchmarks
license: Derived benchmark metadata for in-app guidance; verify upstream source terms before redistribution
description: City-specific house-purchase benchmarks for Lisbon, Porto, and Faro. This dataset is intentionally limited to townhouses, villas, and detached homes and excludes apartment purchases, whole-building deals, and land-only plots.
preprocessing: Built a compact benchmark dataset from current Portugal city purchase guides already retrievable by NestGPT
Kept only house-oriented purchase examples for supported cities
Excluded apartment purchases, whole buildings, and land-only transactions
Stored a small prompt-sized sample with notes and upstream source URLs per record
